Alex (PM): quick sync — we need a clear decision on the pricing matrix for the enterprise pilot. TL;DR: sales wants flexibility, finance wants predictable revenue, eng wants guardrails.
Raj (Sales): customer A asked for per-endpoint caps + soft surge. they want to avoid commit large upfront.
Jules (Finance): we can do soft surge, but revenue visibility drops. need rules for overage billing and minimums.
Marta (Eng): from runtime side, per-endpoint caps are doable but increases routing complexity and monitoring. autoscaling hits are the main risk.
Alex (PM): Proposal: 3 authorization lanes — Standard (metered), Reserved (monthly commitment), Reserve+Soft (commit + soft surge with capped overage). Keep it simple for launch.
Raj (Sales): sounds reasonable. can we allow conversion credits for pilot customers? they want a trial-to-commit path.
Jules (Finance): conversion credits ok if we set an expiry and non-refundable portion. need a simple formula: credit = min(0.25*commit, usage_over_trial).
Marta (Eng): engineering ask: we need to enforce per-tenant burst ceilings in router and a graceful throttling policy. otherwise noisy tenant will degrade 95th pct latency.
Alex (PM): critical launch criteria checklist: 1) billing rules documented, 2) per-tenant caps enforced, 3) observability dashboards for cost/latency, 4) legal clause for surge exceptions.
Raj (Sales): timeline note: customer A needs pilot start in 6 weeks. can we hit that if we scope MVP?
Marta (Eng): engineering can do caps + basic dashboards in 4 weeks if we scope down: no per-endpoint QoS at launch, single global cap per tenant.
Jules (Finance): agree to single global cap to reduce billing complexity. we can add per-endpoint later as an add-on.
Alex (PM): decision: MVP will include Reserved and Reserve+Soft lanes with single global tenant cap. Add-on: per-endpoint caps and conversion credits flow in Q2.
Raj (Sales): I'll confirm with customer A and negotiate conversion credit terms (expiry + 50% non-refundable).
Marta (Eng): ops note — need an implementation ticket: ROUTER-423 to add tenant cap + backpressure. also dashboard ticket: OBS-129.
ops-bot: Meeting scheduled: Pricing pilot decision review — 2024-06-12 10:00AM (UTC).
Alex (PM): next steps — Raj to share customer acceptance criteria, Jules to draft billing formula doc, Marta to start implementation spike. I'll capture risks and escalate if tradeoffs required.
Raj (Sales): 👍 will share acceptance criteria by EOD Friday.
Jules (Finance): I'll drop a short doc in docs/pricing with the credit formula and invoice flow.
Marta (Eng): starting spike tomorrow, will post findings in the thread. any constraints from legal?
Alex (PM): legal wants explicit language for surge carveouts; we'll loop them in once billing doc is up.
Raj (Sales): thanks all — I’ll ping once customer confirms the pilot SOW items. :thumbsup:
